lede: The most consequential thing on the calendar this week happens Tuesday at the Ecology Commission, where a proposed ordinance would ban gas-powered lawn and garden equipment townwide — leaf blowers first by 2028, everything else by 2030. The Housing Authority Subcommittee also takes up a real decision Tuesday: whether to grant a deed-restricted homeowner a $160,000 roofing exception that runs 57% of their original purchase price. Around those meetings, the week opens with Thanksgiving traditions — Turkey Trot, Outlaw Thanksgiving, Will Ski 4 Food on the slopes — before rolling into the usual mix of live music, trivia, and community gatherings.

notable.stake: Vote on ordinance banning gas lawn equipment townwide by 2028–2030.
Board decides whether deed-restricted owner can exceed capital improvement limits.
